description: DSQGenBinary.generate_with_parameters (benchbox/core/tpcds/c_tools.py:890-921) is a no-op: it renders with dsqgen first, then replaces [NAME] tokens that no longer exist. dsqgen -QUALIFY does not change values (tested). The spec lists qualification values in the same NAME.NN = value vocabulary that -LOG writes (verified in the spec text: MANUFACT.01 = 738, REASON.01 = reason 28, matching the DataFrame defaults for Q41 and Q93). A prior reviewer rendered qualification SQL by staging templates with constant defines (define YEAR=2001;) for Q39, Q44 and Q93 and saw -LOG echo the values; I did not re-run that. Spike the approach, including Q8's 400-zip ulist, then delete or replace the stub.
